mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fridge_inventory WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM fridge_inventory WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT fi.* FROM fridge_inventory fi LEFT JOIN fruit_dict fd ON fi.fruit_id = fd.id WHERE fi.device_id = #{deviceId} AND fi.is_deleted = 0 AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, fi.entry_time, NOW()) >= CASE WHEN fi.state = 0 THEN fd.shelf_life_whole * 0.8 ELSE fd.shelf_life_cut * 0.8 END
